selection: Purposive four-paper teaching sample; profile chosen with prior knowledge of the papers, not blinded validation.

cornella2024-50DA.reason: Relevant relative UTS recovery; absolute healed UTS not extracted.

li2016-1to2.reason: Reported healing efficiency is fracture-strain recovery under a different repair protocol.

terryn2017-J4000.reason: Device tests and projected storage-modulus recovery do not supply matched coupon UTS measurements.

montarnal2011-hard.reason: Pristine strength and powder remolding do not establish partial-cut repair.

li-ambient-fracture-strain.reason: Mean 90% meets the inclusive bound; reported SD spans it. Conservative policy, not a confidence test.

li-cold-fracture-strain.reason: Reported 68 plus/minus 2% is below 90% at the matching -20 C, 72 h protocol only.
